text:
maria: Hey team — quick status on the token-attrib + latency breakdown work. TL;DR: milestone A (event schema v1 -> v2) is ready for handoff but I'm shifting ownership from @kai to @sasha next week. Two open deps: event-ingest rename and the cost-proxy rollout. Any blockers?

kai: Ack. PR #432 is in review, it renames `tokens.count` -> `usage.tokens` and adds a sampling flag. Integration tests are failing on one fixture (sequence alignment). I'll push a fix today.

sasha: I can take over on Monday, thanks @maria. Quick Q: do we have a matrix of dashboards/datasources that will break on the rename? I have a maintenance freeze Tue-Wed and want to schedule the rollout accordingly.

tyler: cost-proxy rollout looks good in staging but we saw a debounce issue for concurrent requests yesterday (spiky latency). Plan: patch debounce, then gradual canary Wed morning. tagging @maria and @kai.

analytics-bot: deploy-bot: canary started on staging at 2026-03-16T09:45Z (build 20260316.9). No errors reported in first 30m. :white_check_mark:

maria: Sasha — for the handoff: you own the rollback plan if sample rates drift >3% or latency SLO increases >20ms. Also you'll own the schema docs and migration notes unless you want to delegate.

sasha: OK to own rollback + docs. For docs I'll need infra SME help to add the KV cache note. @kai can you add a short snippet to the event schema explaining `usage.tokens` vs the old fields and an example payload?

kai: Yep. I'll add a code sample plus a tiny migration snippet. Example migration I'll drop into the PR:

```sql
-- backfill old tokens.count into new usage.tokens
UPDATE events
SET payload = jsonb_set(payload, '{usage,tokens}', (payload->'tokens'->'count'))
WHERE payload ? 'tokens';
```

maria: Also analytics ask — can the analytics team produce a 48h time series of token attribution by model_variant and route? Share CSV in #analytics-snapshots when ready. We need to validate the cost mapping.

tyler: Will do. ETA end of day tomorrow. Note: exclude internal test traffic — filter: `source != \"internal-test\"`. Also we should tag requests with `trace_id` for cross-checks.

sasha: One more blocker from billing — they want an optional `billing_unit` string added to the event schema so finance can join on a cost center. Is that acceptable?

maria: Fine to add `billing_unit` as optional string. @kai please add to the PR and make sure the migration keeps the field null for legacy events. Also add a unit test that ensures samples aren't double-counted.

kai: Will add `billing_unit` optional and a test. I'll also add a small note about how the sampling flag interacts with attribution so it doesn't skew cost numbers.

maria: Great. Final: small rollout plan — patch integration tests today, merge PR after green CI, canary Wed, full roll Fri EOD if no regressions. Next async checkin Thurs 10am. Thanks all :thumbsup:
